entities.name: Query LeuC protein
observations: 483 aa sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A1R7K0, annotated as 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large subunit.
Pfam identifies the Aconitase domain PF00330 spanning residues 7–462.
The protein is the large subunit of a heterodimeric LeuC/LeuD enzyme complex.

entities.name: 3-isopropylmalate isomerization
observations: This is an isomerization/dehydration-rehydration chemistry rather than a net redox reaction.

entities.name: [4Fe-4S] cluster
observations: The enzyme binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster per subunit.
The cluster is annotated as a cofactor for 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase activity.

entities.name: L-leucine biosynthesis
observations: The reaction is step 2 of 4 in biosynthesis of L-leucine from 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate.
